summary: Lesson 14: Fluid Timeline, alongside Medication Timeline BP/HR. Reuses the same before/nearest-in-window-after bracket pairing, generalized off fluid log entries instead of med doses. Entries logged within 10 minutes are combined into one drinking event (summed ounces, earliest timestamp); events at or above 8oz get a bracket card. Fixed 90-minute window, grounded in the water-pressor response literature (Jordan et al.) rather than the meal-based PPH window. BP cards flag a systolic change of 20+ mmHg in either direction, rise or drop, since the evidence points to rise as the more likely direction for cardiac/older patients. HR cards stay neutral, no established threshold to flag against. Honest 'no reading in window' message when there isn't one, same rule as meds.
